blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – Final Four MANILA, Philippines—The UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball Final Four games will have to wait a bit longer, with two playoff games set for Wednesday at Philsports Arena. The knockout match between La Salle and University of Santo Tomas will settle the last remaining Final Four spot, while the battle between National University and Far Eastern University will determine the owner of the other coveted twice-to-beat advantage.
